purpose: Translate the synthetically confirmed PA-NF v5 decoupled reference-gauge mechanism to real paired SCORPION DINOv2 features without treating SCORPION as untouched external confirmation.
evidence_class: real-data translation bridge; not independent confirmation
scientific_hypothesis: On real same-tissue multi-scanner features, explicit inverse acquisition transport before biological encoding improves scanner-stable tissue representation versus an exact-capacity no-inverse control while separately supporting positive scanner-operator transport.

preprocessing.fit_scope: AT2 rows from the train split only, separately within each fold
steps: fit per-feature mean/std on AT2 train rows only
standardize all scanner rows using those AT2-train statistics
fit deterministic PCA-32 by SVD on standardized AT2 train rows only
fix each PCA component sign by requiring its largest-absolute loading to be positive
fit projected-score mean/std on AT2 train rows only
standardize projected 32-D scores using those AT2-train statistics
preprocessing.rationale: preserve the confirmed v5 32-D operator mechanism without allowing dimensionality reduction to learn scanner invariance

model.scanner_operator_family: v5 ScannerOperator: exact orthogonal matrix exponential basis + diagonal log-scale + shift
model.scanner_count_adaptation: SCORPION has five scanners rather than the six synthetic v5 scanners; the per-scanner operator family and biological encoder/decoder are unchanged.

training.heldout_calibration_updates: heldout scanner operator parameters only; encoder, decoder and all other operators frozen

evaluation.seed_handling: average seeds within fold, heldout scanner, model family and slide before candidate-control contrasts
evaluation.scanner_holdout_handling: average the four preregistered heldout-scanner contrasts within each slide before primary inference
primary_metrics: candidate operator-only heldout scanner transport gain

requirements: candidate and control parameter counts exactly equal in every fit
lower 95% slide-bootstrap bound of candidate operator-only heldout transport gain > 0
lower 95% slide-bootstrap bound of candidate operator-only known-scanner transport gain > 0
lower 95% slide-bootstrap bound of control-minus-candidate heldout alignment MSE > 0
lower 95% slide-bootstrap bound of candidate-minus-control heldout retrieval top1 >= -0.02
lower 95% slide-bootstrap bound of control-minus-candidate known-scanner probe accuracy > 0

must_bind: heldout scanner schedule fixed to all four non-reference scanners
heldout operator exclusion from shared optimizer
slide-level seed averaging and bootstrap unit
path_obligations.current_surface_gap: PATH v0.3 syntax can declare the dataset, pairing, slide split, frozen encoder and factorization, but not yet the scanner-specific optimizer exclusion/calibration-role semantics; these remain explicit execution obligations for RT1 and should fail closed if not verified.

claim_boundary: A pass is real paired-acquisition translation evidence that the confirmed v5 mechanism survives this previously used SCORPION benchmark under a newly frozen leave-one-scanner-out calibration protocol. It is not independent external confirmation, does not establish pixel-level scanner invertibility, clinical robustness, diagnostic benefit, or deployment readiness, and cannot be used to select McGill analysis rules after McGill outcomes are seen.
